name: Smith Machine Squat
cues: Feet slightly in front of the bar
Brace, then sit down between your heels
Drive the floor away, knees track over toes
instructions: Set the bar at shoulder height, step under it so it rests across your upper back, and place your feet slightly ahead of the bar.
Unhook the bar by twisting it, take a breath and brace your midsection.
Bend your knees and hips to sit straight down until your thighs are about parallel, knees following your toes.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up, then twist the bar back onto the hooks when the set is done.

name: Smith Machine Front Squat
cues: Elbows up, bar on the front delts
Stay tall through the whole rep
instructions: Set the Smith bar at upper-chest height. Step under it and rest it on the front of your shoulders, arms crossed or fingertips under the bar.
Unhook the bar with feet about shoulder width, directly under or slightly ahead of the bar.
Keeping elbows high and torso upright, squat until thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up through the whole foot and re-rack the bar at the end of the set.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
cues: Elbows push knees out at the bottom
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest, cupping the top head with both hands.
Stand with feet a little wider than shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Squat down between your legs, keeping chest up and elbows inside the knees.
Drive back up through the whole foot to standing.

name: Leg Press
cues: Lower back stays on the pad
Lower until knees are near your chest
Do not lock the knees at the top
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back and hips flat against the pad, feet hip width in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles and bend your knees, lowering the platform until your knees come close to your chest.
Push the platform away through your whole foot, keeping your lower back pressed into the pad.
Stop just short of locking your knees, then start the next rep. Reset the safeties when you finish.

name: Hack Squat Machine
cues: Back and hips flat against the pad
Control the descent to full depth
instructions: Step onto the platform with feet shoulder width, shoulders under the pads and your back flat against the backrest.
Release the safety handles and bend your knees to lower yourself as deep as you can control.
Press through the middle of your feet to straighten your legs, keeping your hips on the pad.
Stop just short of locking your knees, then lower for the next rep. Reset the safeties when you finish.

name: Smith Machine Deadlift
cues: Chest up, back flat before you pull
Push the floor away, lock out with glutes
instructions: Set the Smith bar on its lowest safe hooks (or pins around mid-shin). Stand with mid-foot under the bar, feet hip width.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs. Flatten your back and pull the slack out of the bar.
Unhook the bar and stand up by pushing the floor away, hips and shoulders rising together.
Lower under control by pushing the hips back, touching the pins or stopping just below the knee.

name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
cues: Bar stays in contact with the thighs
Stop when hamstrings are tight, not when the back rounds
instructions: Set the bar at mid-thigh height, grip it just outside your legs, and unhook it standing tall with feet hip width.
Unlock your knees slightly and send your hips back, letting the bar slide down along your thighs.
Lower until you feel a strong pull in your hamstrings, keeping your back flat the whole way.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Stop when hamstrings are tight, not when the back rounds
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, feet hip width, knees softly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down the front of your legs, keeping your back flat.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch (usually around mid-shin).
Drive the hips forward to stand back up, squeezing the glutes at the top.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
cues: Dumbbells beside the feet, not in front
Brace and flatten the back first
Stand tall, do not lean back
instructions: Stand with feet hip width, a dumbbell on the floor on each side of your feet.
Squat and hinge down to grip the handles, chest up and back flat.
Stand up by driving through your feet, keeping the dumbbells close to your legs.
Lower them back to the floor under control, hips back first.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hips stay square, toes of the back leg point down
Reach the back heel to the wall
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in the hand opposite your standing leg. Stand tall with a soft knee.
Hinge forward at the hip while the free leg reaches straight back, hips square to the floor.
Lower until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor or the hamstring is fully stretched.
Drive the standing hip forward to return to tall. Finish all reps, then switch sides.

name: Smith Machine Good Morning
cues: Start light, this is a stretch movement
Hips back, chest down, back flat
Knees stay softly bent the whole time
instructions: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and position it across your upper back as for a squat.
Unhook with feet hip width and knees softly bent.
Push the hips back and lower the chest toward the floor with a flat back until the hamstrings are tight.
Drive the hips forward to return to standing.

name: Cable Pull-Through
cues: Walk out far enough for tension at the top
Snap the hips through and squeeze
instructions: Set a rope on a low pulley, face away from the stack and grab the rope between your legs, then step forward until the cable is tight.
Stand with feet a little wider than hips, then push your hips back and let your arms hang as the rope travels between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes hard at the top.
Hinge back again under control, keeping your back flat and knees softly bent.

name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Hips do the work, arms are ropes
Stand tall and squeeze at the top
instructions: Stand with feet a bit wider than hip width, the kettlebell on the floor a foot in front of you.
Hinge, grab the handle with both hands and hike it back between your legs.
Snap the hips forward to float the bell to chest height; arms stay loose.
Let the bell fall back between the legs and hinge to absorb it, then repeat.

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
cues: Long stance, both feet pointing forward
Drop the back knee straight down
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and set a long split stance, both feet facing forward.
Bend both knees to sink straight down until your back knee is just above the floor.
Press through your front heel to rise back up, keeping your torso upright.
Complete all reps on this leg, then switch your stance and repeat on the other side.

name: Bodyweight Split Squat
cues: Long stance, both feet pointing forward
Drop the back knee straight down
instructions: Take a long split stance, feet hip width apart and both pointing forward, hands on hips.
Lower straight down until the back knee nearly touches the floor, front shin close to vertical.
Drive through the front heel to stand back up. Finish the set, then switch legs.

name: Smith Machine Split Squat
cues: Front foot slightly ahead of the bar
Torso tall, back knee straight down
instructions: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and position it across your upper back.
Unhook and step one foot forward and one back into a long split stance.
Lower the back knee straight down toward the floor, front shin roughly vertical.
Drive through the front foot to stand. Finish all reps, then switch legs.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Find the stance before adding load
Most weight on the front foot
instructions: Stand about two feet in front of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand. Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower until the front thigh is about parallel, back knee dropping toward the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand. Finish all reps, then switch legs.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
cues: Step back, not out to the side
Front knee stays over the foot
Push through the front heel to return
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width, a dumbbell hanging at each side.
Take a long step straight back with one foot and lower until the back knee is just above the floor.
Keep the front knee over the middle of the foot and your chest upright as you descend.
Push through the front heel to bring the back foot forward to standing, then step back with the other leg.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering the back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg straight through into the next step.
Keep walking, alternating legs, until all reps are done.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and stand with feet together.
Take a big step out to one side and sit the hips back over that foot, trail leg straight.
Push off the working foot to return to the start. Alternate sides or finish one side first.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
cues: Drive through the top leg, not the bottom foot
instructions: Stand facing a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight at your sides.
Place one whole foot on the bench, then press through that heel to step up until you stand tall on top.
Step the trailing foot down slowly, keeping your weight on the working leg as you lower.
Keep the same leg on the bench for the set, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet well past shoulder width, toes turned out, holding one dumbbell by its top end at arm's length between your legs.
Keep your chest up and sit straight down between your heels, knees pushing out over your toes.
Go as low as you can while your back stays flat, then press through your whole foot to stand.

name: Smith Machine Sumo Squat
cues: Feet wide and slightly ahead of the bar
Knees out the whole way down
instructions: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and rest it across your upper back.
Stand with your feet well past shoulder width under the bar, toes turned out, and unhook the bar.
Sit straight down, knees pushing out over your toes, until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your whole foot to stand, then rack the bar when the set is done.

name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet well past shoulder width, toes turned out, holding a kettlebell by the handle at arm's length.
Sit straight down between your heels, knees pushing out, until the bell nearly touches the floor.
Press through your whole foot to stand tall.

name: Leg Extension
cues: Knee lined up with the machine pivot
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point.
Hook the roller pad just above your ankles and hold the side handles.
Straighten your legs to lift the pad, then hold the top briefly while tightening your thighs.
Bend your knees slowly to lower the weight back down without letting the stack touch.

name: Single-Leg Extension
cues: Hips stay down on the seat
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and one ankle behind the roller, knee lined up with the pivot.
Hold the handles and straighten that leg until it is fully extended, keeping your hips down on the seat.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the weight slowly until the knee is bent again.
Finish the set, then switch legs and do the same number of reps.

name: Reverse Nordic
cues: Hips stay locked, straight line to the head
Only go as far as you can come back from
instructions: Kneel on a mat with knees hip width and shins flat, body upright.
Keeping a straight line from knees to head, lean back as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up to upright with your quads, without bending at the hips.

name: Seated Leg Curl
cues: Thigh pad snug, knees at the pivot
instructions: Sit in the machine with the backs of your ankles on the lower pad and lock the thigh pad down snugly.
Line your knees up with the machine's pivot and hold the side handles.
Bend your knees to pull the pad down and back as far as it will go.
Let the pad rise slowly until your legs are nearly straight, then repeat.

name: Lying Leg Curl
cues: Lower slowly, do not let it drop
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with the roller pad resting just above your heels and your knees just off the bench edge.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed down into the pad.
Bend your knees to pull the pad up toward your glutes as far as you can.
Straighten your legs slowly to lower the pad, keeping tension the whole way down.

name: Nordic Curl
cues: Hips stay extended, no bending at the waist
Fight the fall all the way down
Use your hands as little as possible
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your heels hooked under something solid (a loaded Smith bar set low, or a secure machine pad).
Keeping a straight line from knees to shoulders, lower yourself toward the floor as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands, then push off lightly and pull back up with the hamstrings.

name: Standing Calf Raise Machine
cues: Full stretch at the bottom, pause
instructions: Step under the shoulder pads with the balls of your feet on the platform edge and your heels hanging off.
Stand tall with straight legs and let your heels sink until you feel a full stretch in your calves, then pause.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can, pushing through the big toe side of your feet.
Lower slowly back into the stretch without bouncing, and repeat.

name: Seated Calf Raise
cues: Pad sits just above the knees
instructions: Sit on the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform edge and the pad resting just above your knees.
Lift the pad slightly and release the safety lever, then let your heels drop into a deep stretch.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Lower back to the stretch slowly. Re-engage the safety lever when the set is done.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
cues: Balls of the feet on a plate for range
instructions: Set a weight plate under the bar and stand with the balls of your feet on its edge, bar across your upper back.
Unhook the bar and let your heels drop below the plate for a full stretch, knees straight.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can and pause briefly at the top.
Lower your heels slowly back into the stretch. Rack the bar when the set is done.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot with the ball of the foot on a plate or step, holding a dumbbell in the same-side hand and a support with the other.
Lower the heel as far as you can for a full stretch.
Rise as high as possible onto the big toe, pause, and lower slowly. Finish the set, then switch legs.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot with the ball of the foot on a stair edge (or flat on the floor), holding a wall or rail for balance.
Lower the heel as far as you can for a full stretch.
Rise as high as possible onto the big toe, pause, and lower slowly. Finish the set, then switch legs.

name: 45° Back Extension
cues: Pad just below the hip crease
Hinge at the hips, not the low back
Squeeze glutes to come up, stop at straight
instructions: Set the pad so it sits just below your hip crease, then lock your heels under the foot rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and bend forward at the hips, keeping your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your torso until your body forms a straight line, without arching past it.
Lower back down under control and repeat.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor close to your glutes, and arms by your sides.
Brace your stomach so your ribs stay down, then press through your heels to lift your hips.
Rise until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders and squeeze your glutes for two seconds.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat, the other leg straight out or tucked toward your chest.
Push through the heel of your planted foot to lift your hips off the floor.
Pause at the top with your hips level and your glute squeezed.
Lower your hips back down slowly. Finish the set, then switch legs.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
cues: Chin tucked, ribs down, lock out with glutes
instructions: Set a bench lengthwise beside the Smith machine and the bar low. Sit with your upper back against the bench and the bar (with a pad) over your hips.
Plant your feet about shoulder width, knees bent, and unhook the bar.
Drive through your heels to lift the hips until your torso is level, chin tucked.
Pause and squeeze the glutes, then lower under control.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and the pads resting on the inside of your knees.
Set the starting width so your legs are open to a comfortable stretch, and hold the handles.
Squeeze your legs together until the pads meet, pausing briefly.
Let your legs open slowly back to the start, keeping the weight from crashing down.

name: Cable Hip Adduction
cues: Sweep the leg across the body
instructions: Strap the ankle nearest a low pulley, then step out sideways until the cable pulls that leg out to the side.
Hold the tower with one hand and stand tall on your outside leg.
Pull the strapped leg across in front of your standing leg, keeping your torso still.
Let the leg return out to the side under control. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Copenhagen Plank
cues: Knee on the bench is the easy version, ankle is harder
Squeeze the top leg down into the bench
instructions: Lie on your side with your top leg resting on a bench (at the gym) or a couch or chair seat (at home), bottom forearm on the floor.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line, supported by the forearm and the inside of the top leg.
Hold, breathing steadily, then lower. Switch sides. Start with the knee on the bench to shorten the lever.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
cues: Sit tall or lean slightly forward
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads against the outsides of your knees and hold the handles.
Sit tall or tip slightly forward from the hips, feet resting on the foot bars.
Press your knees outward against the pads as far as you comfortably can.
Let the pads come back together slowly without letting the weight stack rest.

name: Cable Hip Abduction
cues: Lead with the heel, toes forward
Small range is fine, no swinging
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and to the ankle farther from the machine. Stand side-on, holding the tower.
Sweep the working leg out to the side, leading with the heel, without leaning the torso.
Return slowly. Finish the set, then switch legs.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your side on a mat, bottom knee bent, top leg straight and in line with your body.
Lift the top leg toward the ceiling, heel slightly back and toes pointing forward.
Lower slowly without letting the leg touch down. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Set a flat bench under the bar so it lines up with your mid-chest, then lie down with feet flat on the floor.
Pinch your shoulder blades together, grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders, and twist it off the hooks.
Lower the bar under control until it touches your chest, elbows angled slightly in from your sides.
Press back up to straight arms, then twist the bar onto the hooks when the set is done.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Kick the dumbbells up off your knees
Deep stretch, press up and slightly in
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench with dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back and use your knees to bring them up over your chest.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, elbows angled about 45 degrees from your body.
Press them back up and slightly toward each other until your arms are straight over your chest.
Lower again under control, and when finished bring the dumbbells back to your knees before sitting up.

name: Machine Chest Press
cues: Shoulder blades back against the pad
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit level with the middle of your chest, then sit with your back flat on the pad.
Grip the handles and pull your shoulder blades back into the seat.
Push the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight, without slamming your elbows into lockout.
Bring the handles back slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench under the bar with feet planted, and grip the bar with hands about shoulder width apart.
Set your shoulder blades back and twist the bar off the hooks.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked close to your body.
Press up until your arms are straight, then rack the bar when the set is done.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to a low incline, sit back with a dumbbell on each thigh, and kick them up to shoulder level as you lie back.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest with your feet planted and shoulder blades pulled back.
Press up until your arms are straight above your collarbones.
Lower under control for the next rep, then return the dumbbells to your thighs when finished.

name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
cues: Bench placed so the bar meets the upper chest
instructions: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar so the bar lines up with your upper chest, then lie back.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width, pull your shoulder blades down and back, and unhook it.
Lower the bar under control until it lightly touches your upper chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight, then twist the bar to rack it after the last rep.

name: Incline Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Press
cues: Elbows stay close to the body
Squeeze the chest at the top
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lie back and bring the dumbbells up beside your chest, palms facing each other and elbows close to your sides.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight over your upper chest, squeezing your chest at the top.
Lower them slowly back to the sides of your chest and repeat.

name: Assisted Dip Machine
cues: Lean forward for chest, stay upright for triceps
Shoulders down, away from the ears
instructions: Set the assistance weight, kneel or stand on the platform and grip the dip handles with arms straight.
Lean your torso slightly forward and lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms without shrugging.

name: Incline Push-Up
cues: Hands on a bench or Smith bar
instructions: Place your hands on the edge of a bench slightly wider than your shoulders and walk your feet back.
Brace so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest to the bench edge, elbows angled back slightly.
Push the bench away to straighten your arms, keeping your hips in line.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep your hips from sagging.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor until it nearly touches.
Push the floor away to straighten your arms and return to the plank.

name: Decline Push-Up
cues: Feet on the bench, hands under shoulders
Do not let the hips sag
instructions: Place your feet on a bench behind you and your hands on the floor just under your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes so your body is straight from heels to head.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest close to the floor without letting your hips sag.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight again, and repeat.

name: Cable Crossover (High to Low)
cues: Hands meet in front of the hips
instructions: Set both pulleys high, take a handle in each hand and step forward into a staggered stance with a slight forward lean.
Start with your arms out wide, elbows softly bent and chest open.
Sweep the handles down and in until your hands meet in front of your hips, squeezing your chest.
Let your arms open back out slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys at the lowest position, grab a handle in each hand and step forward to stand between them.
Start with your arms down and slightly back, palms facing forward and elbows softly bent.
Sweep both hands up and together in an arc until they meet around chin height.
Lower your arms back down and out along the same path, under control.

name: Pec Deck
cues: Seat so handles are at chest height
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your chest, then sit with your back flat against the pad.
Take the handles with a slight bend in your elbows, chest lifted and shoulders pulled back.
Bring your arms together in a wide arc until the handles meet in front of your chest, then squeeze.
Let your arms open slowly back to the start, stopping at a comfortable stretch.

name: Dumbbell Fly
cues: Open until a stretch, not further
Bring them up like hugging a tree
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold the dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Keep the elbow bend fixed and bring the dumbbells back up along the same arc.
Stop when they are over your chest, then lower for the next rep.

name: Dumbbell Curl
cues: Turn the pinkies up at the top
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight at your sides and palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbows tight to your sides, curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
At the top, rotate your wrists a little so your little fingers turn upward, and squeeze.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to full arm length without swinging.

name: Cable Curl
cues: Step back so there is tension at the bottom
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley, grip it palms up at shoulder width, and step back so the cable stays tight.
Stand tall with your elbows pinned at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, squeezing your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight, keeping tension on the cable.

name: Machine Preacher Curl
cues: Do not fully relax at the bottom
instructions: Adjust the seat so your armpits rest snugly on the top of the pad and your arms lie flat down it.
Grip the handles with palms up and arms nearly straight.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders as far as they will go.
Lower slowly, stopping just short of full relaxation at the bottom before the next rep.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
cues: Back of the arm flat on the bench back
Stop just short of locking out
instructions: Set an adjustable bench upright and stand behind it, resting the back of one arm flat on the backrest, dumbbell in hand.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm on the pad.
Lower it slowly until your arm is almost straight, stopping just short of locking out.
Finish all reps on this arm, then switch to the other side.

name: Dumbbell Spider Curl
cues: Chest on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down
instructions: Set a bench to an incline and lie chest down on it, a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms pointing straight at the floor and palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders without letting your elbows drift, and squeeze hard at the top.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight again.

name: Concentration Curl
cues: Elbow braced on the inner thigh
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with feet wide and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Lean forward and brace the back of that elbow against your inner thigh, arm hanging straight.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your opposite shoulder and pause briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Bench at 45–60°, arms hang straight down
Elbows stay back, do not swing forward
instructions: Set a bench to a 45 to 60 degree incline and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down.
Keep your elbows pointed down and slightly behind your body throughout.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower them all the way until your arms are fully straight and you feel a stretch.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
cues: Do not lean into the curl
instructions: Set a single handle on a low pulley. Face away from the tower and take a step forward so the working arm is pulled behind your body.
Staggered stance, chest up, elbow behind the torso.
Curl the handle up without letting the elbow drift forward, then lower to a full stretch. Finish the set, then switch arms.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at each side, palms facing your legs.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides and your thumbs pointing up.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists.
Lower them slowly back down until your arms are straight.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your legs.
Keeping your palm facing in, curl one dumbbell up and across toward the opposite side of your chest.
Lower it under control along the same path while your upper arm stays still.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides each rep.

name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
cues: Pull the rope ends apart at the top
instructions: Attach a rope to the low pulley and hold an end in each hand, palms facing each other, standing close to the stack.
Pin your elbows at your sides and curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
At the top, spread the rope ends apart slightly and squeeze.
Lower the rope slowly until your arms are straight again.

name: Incline Hammer Curl
cues: Arms hang straight down from the bench
instructions: Sit back on a bench set to a moderate incline, a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging straight down.
Turn your palms to face your body so your thumbs point forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, keeping your thumbs up and upper arms still.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight and you feel a stretch, then repeat.

name: Reverse-Grip Cable Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and hold it with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder width.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides and wrists straight.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight, keeping tension on the cable.

name: Reverse Dumbbell Curl
cues: Palms face down the whole rep
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing behind you, arms straight at your sides.
Keep your wrists straight and your elbows close to your body.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, keeping your palms down the whole way.
Lower them slowly back to your thighs.

name: Zottman Curl
cues: Rotate to palms down at the top
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each side, palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders, keeping your elbows at your sides.
At the top, rotate your wrists so your palms face down.
Lower the dumbbells slowly with palms down, then turn them back up at the bottom for the next rep.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
cues: Pull elbows down to your back pockets
Bar to the upper chest, slight lean back
instructions: Grip the long bar well outside shoulder width with palms facing away, then sit with your thighs locked under the pads.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight and your lats are stretched.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
cues: Chest up to meet the handle
instructions: Attach a close neutral grip handle, sit with your thighs under the pads and reach up to grab it.
Let your arms straighten fully overhead so you feel a stretch through your back.
Lift your chest and pull the handle down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arms are straight again.

name: Underhand Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads and grab the bar palms toward you, hands shoulder width.
Lean back just slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back, keeping your torso still.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight overhead, and repeat.

name: Single-Arm Cable Pulldown
cues: Pull the elbow down to the hip
instructions: Set a single handle on a high pulley and sit or kneel facing it, holding the handle in one hand with your arm reaching up.
Let your shoulder lift to stretch your lat, keeping your torso square.
Pull your elbow down toward your hip without twisting.
Return the handle up slowly until your arm is fully extended. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
cues: Chest to the bar, elbows to the ribs
instructions: Set the assistance weight, kneel or stand on the platform and take an overhand grip a little wider than shoulders.
Start from a full hang with shoulders active, then pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower under control to full arm extension.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Grab the bar with your palms facing you, hands about shoulder width, and hang with your arms straight.
Pull your shoulders down, then pull yourself up by driving your elbows toward your ribs.
Keep going until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly back to a full hang before the next rep.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Grab the bar with palms facing away, hands a little wider than your shoulders, and hang with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down and back, then drive your elbows toward your ribs.
Pull until your chin clears the bar, without swinging or kicking.
Lower yourself under control all the way back to a dead hang.

name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Pull to the belly button, squeeze shoulder blades
Let the shoulders reach forward on the return
instructions: Sit at the row station with feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and grab the handle with arms straight.
Sit tall and pull the handle toward your belly button, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Hold the squeeze briefly with your chest up and torso still.
Extend your arms slowly and let your shoulders reach forward before the next rep.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Hand and knee on the bench, back flat
Pull the elbow to the hip
Let it stretch at the bottom
instructions: Place one knee and the same side hand on a flat bench, back flat, and hold a dumbbell in your other hand.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down so you feel a stretch through your side.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower it slowly back to the stretch. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cues: Chest stays on the incline pad
Drive the elbows back and up
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest down on it, a dumbbell in each hand hanging below your shoulders.
Keep your chest on the pad and your neck in line with your spine.
Row the dumbbells up by driving your elbows back and up, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight, and repeat.

name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row
cues: Pull the bar to the lower ribs
instructions: Set the bar at about knee height, grip it slightly wider than shoulders with palms down, and unhook it.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is about 45 degrees, back flat and knees slightly bent.
Pull the bar up to your lower ribs, keeping your hips still.
Lower it until your arms are straight, then re-hook the bar when the set is done.

name: Seated Row Machine
instructions: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and sit with your chest against the pad.
Grab the handles with your arms extended forward.
Pull the handles toward you by driving your elbows back, then hold briefly with your shoulder blades squeezed.
Let your arms extend slowly back to the start.

name: Inverted Row (Smith Bar)
cues: Bar at hip height; higher bar is easier
Pull your chest to the bar
instructions: Set the bar at about hip height, lie underneath it, and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Straighten your body from heels to head with your heels on the floor and arms fully extended.
Pull your chest up to the bar, keeping your hips from sagging.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight. Raise the bar to make it easier.

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
cues: Sweep the bar down to the thighs
Feel the lats, not the triceps
instructions: Attach a straight bar or rope to a high pulley, grip it about shoulder width and step back.
Hinge forward slightly with arms nearly straight and the bar at about eye level.
Sweep the bar down in an arc to your thighs, keeping your elbows fixed and feeling your lats work.
Let it rise back up slowly until you feel a stretch under your arms.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
cues: Hold one dumbbell by the top plate
Lower behind the head with soft elbows
Pull back over the chest using the lats
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold one dumbbell above your chest with both hands cupping the top end.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbell back behind your head until you feel a stretch.
Pull it back up and over your chest by using your lats.
Stop with the dumbbell above your chest, then repeat.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
cues: Shoulders straight up to the ears
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each side, palms facing your legs.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the top for a moment without rolling your shoulders.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down and repeat.

name: Smith Machine Behind-the-Back Shrug
cues: Hold one second at the top
instructions: Set the bar at mid thigh height, stand with your back to it and grip it behind you, hands about shoulder width.
Unhook the bar and stand tall with it resting just behind your thighs, arms straight.
Shrug your shoulders up and slightly back, holding for a second at the top.
Lower your shoulders slowly to the start, then re-hook the bar when finished.

name: Cable Shrug
cues: Straight bar on a low pulley
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand close to the stack holding the bar in front of your thighs.
Keep your arms straight and your body upright.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears and squeeze at the top.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down to a full stretch.

name: Smith Machine Overhead Press
cues: Bench upright, bar in front of the face
Press straight up, head through at the top
instructions: Set an upright bench under the bar so the bar passes just in front of your face, then sit with feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and twist it off the hooks.
Lower the bar to about chin height, then press it straight up until your arms lock out, head moving forward under it.
Lower back to chin height for the next rep, and twist the bar onto the hooks when done.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Back flat against the upright bench
Press up, do not clang at the top
instructions: Set a bench upright, sit with your back flat against it and bring the dumbbells to ear height, palms forward.
Brace your stomach and plant your feet on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are extended, without knocking them together.
Lower them back to ear height under control for the next rep.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height and sit with your back flat on the pad.
Grab the handles with your elbows below your hands.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight, keeping your shoulders down away from your ears.
Lower the handles slowly back to shoulder height.

name: Arnold Press
cues: Start palms facing you at chin height
Rotate to palms forward as you press
Reverse it on the way down
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding the dumbbells in front of your chin, palms facing you.
Press the dumbbells up while turning your palms to face forward.
Finish with arms straight overhead and palms forward.
Reverse the motion on the way down, turning your palms back toward you as they reach chin height.

name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Dumbbell Press
cues: Press in a slight arc to overhead
instructions: Kneel on one knee on a mat with the other foot forward. Hold a dumbbell at the shoulder on the side of the down knee.
Squeeze the glute of the down leg and brace the trunk.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead without leaning, then lower to the shoulder. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Lead with the elbows, slight bend
Raise to shoulder height, no higher
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, elbows slightly bent.
Lead with your elbows and raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop when your arms reach shoulder height, reaching out rather than up.
Lower them slowly back to your sides.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
cues: Cable runs behind or in front of the body
instructions: Set a pulley at the lowest position and stand side on to it, holding the handle in your far hand.
Let the cable cross in front of or behind your body, with a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side until your hand reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly back down. Complete the set, then switch sides.

name: Incline Side-Lying Lateral Raise
cues: Start with the arm hanging across the body
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie on your side against it, a dumbbell in your top hand.
Let the dumbbell hang down across the front of your body with a slight bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up until it points straight at the ceiling, then lower it slowly.
Finish the set, then turn over and switch arms.

name: Face Pull
cues: Pull toward the eyes, elbows high
instructions: Set a rope on a pulley at face height, grip both ends with thumbs toward you and step back until your arms are straight.
Stand tall and pull the rope toward your eyes, elbows high and out to the sides.
Pull the rope ends apart so your hands finish beside your ears with thumbs pointing behind you.
Let your arms extend back to the start under control.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
cues: Sweep the arms out wide, slight elbow bend
Do not squeeze the shoulder blades hard
instructions: Sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad and set the handles to the rear position.
Grab the handles with your arms out in front at shoulder height and elbows slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc, leading with the backs of your shoulders.
Bring the handles forward slowly to the start without letting the stack rest.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Rear-Delt Raise
cues: Raise out to the sides, pinkies high
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward until your chest nears your thighs.
Let the dumbbells hang beneath your legs, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Raise the dumbbells out to your sides until your arms are level with your back, little fingers leading.
Lower them slowly back down without swinging.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
cues: Elbows point forward and stay put
instructions: Attach a rope to a pulley, grab it and turn to face away from the machine with the rope behind your head.
Step into a staggered stance and lean forward slightly, elbows pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to push the rope forward and up, keeping your elbows in place.
Bend your elbows slowly to let the rope come back behind your head for a deep stretch.

name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Extension
cues: Both hands cup the top of one dumbbell
Lower behind the head, press up
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands cupping the top end.
Keep your elbows close together and pointing toward the ceiling.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head until you feel a stretch.
Straighten your arms to press it back overhead.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extension
cues: Free hand supports the working elbow
instructions: Sit on a bench with an upright back pad, holding a dumbbell straight overhead in one hand.
Keep that upper arm close to your ear and support the elbow with your free hand.
Bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head, then straighten your arm to press it back up.
Finish the set, then switch arms.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
cues: Arms angled slightly back toward the head
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding the dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other, arms tilted slightly back toward your head.
Bend only at the elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your ears.
Straighten your arms to bring the dumbbells back up, keeping your upper arms still.
Stop just before your elbows lock, then lower for the next rep.

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
cues: Spread the rope at the bottom
Stop at the chest on the way up
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing it, holding an end in each hand with elbows at your sides.
Push the rope down until your arms are straight.
At the bottom, pull the rope ends apart and squeeze your triceps.
Let your forearms rise slowly until your hands reach chest height, elbows still pinned.

name: V-Bar Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Attach a V-bar to a high pulley and grip it with palms facing each other.
Lean forward slightly and pin your elbows at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight, then squeeze your triceps.
Let the bar rise slowly until your forearms are just above parallel, elbows still at your sides.

name: Reverse-Grip Triceps Pushdown
cues: Palms up on a straight bar
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grip it with palms up, hands about shoulder width.
Stand tall with your elbows tucked tight against your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight, squeezing your triceps.
Let the bar rise slowly until your forearms are just above parallel to the floor.

name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
cues: Free hand on the tower for balance
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley. Stand facing it and grip the handle with one hand.
Pin the elbow to your side and push the handle down until the arm is straight.
Return until the forearm is just above parallel. Finish the set, then switch arms.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
cues: Upper arm parallel to the floor
instructions: Support yourself with one knee and hand on a bench, holding a dumbbell in your free hand.
Raise that upper arm so it sits parallel to the floor, elbow bent at about 90 degrees.
Straighten your arm behind you, moving only the forearm, and squeeze at full extension.
Bend your elbow slowly to return. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Seated Triceps Dip Machine
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and grip the handles at your sides.
Sit tall with your shoulders down and your elbows pointing straight back.
Press the handles down until your arms are fully locked out.
Let the handles rise slowly until your elbows are bent about 90 degrees, and repeat.

name: Bench Dip
cues: Lower until upper arms are parallel, no deeper
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench, hands gripping the edge beside your hips, and walk your feet out.
Slide your hips off the bench so they stay close to it, arms straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and rise back up. Bend your knees to make it easier.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, standing tall.
Walk with short, controlled steps, shoulders down and back, for the prescribed time.
Set the dumbbells down under control by squatting, not bending at the waist.

name: Dumbbell Farmer's Hold
cues: Heaviest dumbbells you can hold for time
Do not let the handles roll
instructions: Stand holding a heavy dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall with shoulders down and squeeze the handles for the prescribed time.
Set the dumbbells down under control.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, about shoulder width.
Lift your feet and hang with arms straight, shoulders lightly engaged.
Hold for the prescribed time, then step down.

name: Towel-Grip Dumbbell Hold
cues: Squeeze, do not just hang on
instructions: Wrap a gym towel tightly around the handle of a dumbbell to make it thick.
Pick it up and hold it at your side with arm straight, squeezing as hard as you can.
Hold for the prescribed time, then switch hands.

name: Dumbbell Finger Curl
cues: Forearms supported, only the fingers move
Let it roll to the fingertips
instructions: Sit on a bench with forearms on your thighs, palms up, a dumbbell in each hand just past the knees.
Let the dumbbell roll down to your fingertips.
Curl the fingers closed to roll it back into your palm, then curl the wrist slightly at the top.

name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Hold
cues: Start light; balance is the hard part
instructions: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle, bell pointing up, elbow bent at 90° in front of you.
Squeeze the handle hard to keep the bell balanced and still.
Hold for the prescribed time, then switch hands.

name: Plate Pinch
cues: Fingers on one side, thumb on the other
Hold at your side for time
instructions: Stack two weight plates together with the smooth faces on the outside.
Pinch them with your fingers on one side and thumb on the other, then lift and hold them at your side.
Keep your grip tight, stand tall and breathe steadily for the whole hold.
When time is up, lower the plates carefully, then switch hands.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
cues: Forearms on the thighs, wrists past the knees
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, forearms resting on your thighs palms up.
Slide forward so your wrists hang just past your knees.
Let the dumbbells roll down toward your fingertips, then curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Lower slowly to the bottom again, keeping your forearms still on your thighs.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
cues: Straight bar on a low pulley
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and sit on a bench facing it, gripping the bar with palms up.
Rest your forearms on your thighs so your wrists hang just past your knees.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can without lifting your forearms.
Lower the bar slowly into a stretch, keeping tension on the cable without bouncing.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
cues: Palms down, forearms on the thighs
Raise the knuckles toward the ceiling
Go light, this muscle is small
instructions: Sit on a bench with your forearms resting on your thighs, palms down, wrists just past your knees with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Let your hands drop toward the floor as far as is comfortable.
Lift your knuckles up toward the ceiling by bending only at the wrist.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back down.

name: Dumbbell Pronation–Supination
cues: Hold one end like a hammer
instructions: Sit with your forearm on your thigh or a bench, holding a light dumbbell by one end so it sticks up like a hammer.
Slowly rotate the palm down until the dumbbell is horizontal, then rotate back through vertical to palm up.
Keep the elbow and forearm still. Finish the set, then switch hands. Choke up on the handle to make it easier.

name: Plank
instructions: Lie face down and set your elbows under your shoulders, forearms flat on the mat.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line from heels to head.
Squeeze your glutes, pull your ribs down, and breathe steadily while you hold.
Hold for the set time without letting your hips sag, then lower your knees to the mat.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout (Kneeling)
cues: Roll out only as far as your low back stays flat
Pull back with the abs, not the hips
instructions: Kneel on a mat holding the ab wheel on the floor below your shoulders.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze your glutes to lock your lower back flat.
Roll the wheel forward slowly, stopping before your lower back starts to sag.
Use your abs to pull the wheel back under your shoulders, without pushing your hips back first.

name: Long-Lever Plank
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank, then walk the elbows a few inches forward of the shoulders.
Squeeze the glutes and quads hard and pull the elbows toward the toes without moving them.
Hold for the prescribed time, breathing behind a braced belly.

name: Body Saw
cues: Move from the shoulders, body stays a plank
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with your feet on a towel on a smooth floor (or socks on hardwood).
Keeping a rigid plank, push your body backward a few inches by moving at the shoulders.
Pull back to the start. Only go as far as you can without the low back sagging.

name: Dead Bug
cues: Low back pressed into the floor
Exhale fully as the limbs reach
instructions: Lie on your back with arms reaching toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees above your hips.
Flatten your low back into the floor and keep it there the whole time.
Slowly extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg out long while breathing out fully.
Bring them back to the start, then repeat with the other arm and leg.

name: Kettlebell Dead Bug
cues: Press the bell up toward the ceiling
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell by the horns over your chest, arms straight. Lift your legs to tabletop.
Keeping the kettlebell still and your low back flat, extend one leg toward the floor.
Return and repeat with the other leg.

name: Hollow Hold
cues: Shorten the lever before you lose position
instructions: Lie on your back, press the low back into the floor and lift the shoulders and legs off the mat.
Reach arms overhead and legs long, as low as you can keep the low back down.
Hold for the prescribed time. Bend the knees or bring the arms forward to make it easier.

name: Bird Dog
cues: Hips stay level, like a glass of water on the back
instructions: Start on hands and knees on a mat, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your torso.
Pause without letting the hips rotate, then return and switch sides.

name: Superman Hold
cues: Look at the floor, neck long
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Squeeze the glutes and lift the arms, chest and legs a few inches off the floor.
Hold for the prescribed time, keeping the neck long, then lower.

name: Band Pull-Through
cues: Arms just hold, hips do the work
Lock out with a glute squeeze
instructions: Anchor a band low in the door. Face away from it, straddle the band and hold it with both hands between your legs.
Walk forward until there is tension. Hinge at the hips, letting your hands travel back between your legs.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall, squeezing the glutes.

name: Crunch
cues: Curl the ribs toward the pelvis
Hands light, do not pull the neck
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and fingertips resting lightly behind your head.
Breathe out and curl your ribs toward your hips, lifting your shoulder blades off the mat.
Pause briefly at the top without pulling on your neck.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down and repeat.

name: Kneeling Band Crunch
cues: Round the spine, do not hinge
instructions: Anchor a band high in the door. Kneel facing it and hold the band beside your head.
Keeping the hips still, crunch down by curling your ribs toward your pelvis.
Return slowly to upright with the abs still tense.

name: Jackknife Sit-Up
cues: Arms and legs meet over the hips
Bend the knees if the back arches
instructions: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and arms stretched overhead on the floor.
Lift your arms and legs together, folding at the hips so your hands meet your shins or feet over your hips.
Lower your arms and legs slowly back toward the floor.
Stop just before touching down and repeat. Bend your knees if your lower back arches.

name: Reverse Crunch
cues: Curl the hips off the floor
Knees toward the chest, not just up
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides and your knees bent, feet lifted off the floor.
Use your abs to curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees in toward your chest.
Pause briefly with your lower back lifted.
Lower your hips slowly back down until your feet hover just off the floor.

name: Flutter Kicks
instructions: Lie on your back with hands under your hips and the low back pressed into the floor.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor, knees straight.
Alternate small up-and-down kicks, keeping the low back down. Count each leg as one rep.

name: Lying Leg Raise
cues: Low back pressed into the floor
Bend the knees a little if needed
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat, legs straight, hands under your hips or by your sides.
Keeping the low back down, raise the legs until they are vertical.
Lower slowly until just above the floor, stopping before the back arches.

name: Band Pallof Press
cues: More steps from the anchor = harder
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height in the door. Stand side-on to it, holding the band at your chest with both hands.
Step away until there is tension, feet shoulder width, knees soft.
Press the hands straight out, resist the pull toward the door, then bring them back to the chest.

name: Half-Kneeling Band Pallof Press
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height. Half-kneel side-on to it, inside knee down, holding the band at your chest.
Squeeze the glute of the down leg and press the hands straight out.
Hold briefly without rotating, then return. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
instructions: Start in a high plank on your hands, feet a little wider than hip width.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder without letting the hips rock.
Return the hand and alternate sides.

name: Kettlebell Plank Pull-Through
cues: Hips stay square to the floor
instructions: Start in a high plank with a kettlebell on the floor just outside one hand, beside your ribs.
Reach under your body with the opposite hand and drag the kettlebell across to the other side.
Return the hand to the floor and repeat with the other hand, keeping hips level.

name: Band Woodchop (High to Low)
cues: Arms stay long, the trunk turns
instructions: Anchor a band high in the door. Stand side-on, feet wide, holding the band with both hands above the near shoulder.
Pull diagonally down across the body to the opposite hip, pivoting the back foot and rotating through the trunk.
Return slowly along the same path. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Band Lift (Low to High)
instructions: Anchor a band low in the door. Stand side-on, feet wide, holding the band with both hands by the near hip.
Pull diagonally up across the body to above the opposite shoulder, rotating through the trunk.
Return slowly along the same path. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Russian Twist
cues: Lean back with a long spine
Rotate the ribs, not just the arms
instructions: Sit on the mat with knees bent and lean back slightly, keeping your spine long.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest and lift your feet if you want it harder.
Turn your ribs and hands to one side, then rotate through the middle to the other side.
Keep alternating sides, counting each turn, until the set is done.

name: Kettlebell Russian Twist
cues: Follow the bell with your eyes
instructions: Sit on a mat with knees bent, holding a kettlebell by the horns at your chest. Lean back to about 45° with a long spine.
Rotate your torso to bring the kettlebell beside one hip.
Rotate through the middle to the other side. Count each side as one rep.

name: Kettlebell Halo
cues: Keep the bell close to the head
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell upside down by the horns in front of your chest.
Circle it around your head, close to the ears and behind the head, keeping the trunk still.
Return to the front and reverse direction on the next rep.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side on a mat with your forearm under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold for the prescribed time, then switch sides. Bend the knees to make it easier.

name: Side Plank with Leg Raise
cues: Breathe, do not hold your breath
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm, body in a straight line.
Lift the top leg to about hip height and hold it there.
Hold for the prescribed time, then switch sides.

name: Kettlebell Suitcase Hold
instructions: Deadlift a kettlebell from the floor beside one foot and stand tall holding it at your side.
Keep the shoulders level and the torso upright without leaning away from the weight.
Hold for the prescribed time, set it down, and switch sides.

name: Kettlebell Suitcase Carry
cues: Do not lean away from the bell
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Walk with short steps for the prescribed time, keeping shoulders level and the torso upright.
Set it down, switch hands and repeat.

name: Double Kettlebell Front-Rack Carry
cues: Ribs down, do not lean back
instructions: Clean a matched pair of kettlebells to the front rack: bells resting on the outside of the forearms, elbows tucked, fists at collarbone height.
Stand tall and walk with short steps for the prescribed time, ribs down and breathing behind the brace.
Lower the bells under control.

name: Overhead Kettlebell Carry
cues: Arm locked, bell stacked over the shoulder
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm, biceps by the ear, wrist straight.
Walk with short steps for the prescribed time, ribs down and arm locked.
Lower the bell to the shoulder and down, then switch arms.

name: Kettlebell Side Bend
cues: Bend straight sideways, no leaning forward
Pull up with the opposite side
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side, other hand on your hip or behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the kettlebell, sliding it down the leg.
Pull yourself back up to upright using the opposite side. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Band Side Bend
instructions: Stand on one end of a band (or anchor it low in the door) and hold the other end in one hand at your side.
Bend sideways away from the band, against its pull.
Return slowly to upright. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Side Plank Hip Dip
cues: Dip, then drive the hip high
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm, body in a straight line.
Lower the bottom hip toward the floor without touching.
Lift the hips back up past straight. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
cues: Eyes on the bell the whole time
Hips push out toward the bell side
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and turn your feet about 45° away from that side.
Keeping the arm locked and eyes on the bell, push the hips toward the bell and slide the free hand down the inside of the front leg.
Go as low as you can with a long spine, then return to standing. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Bar on the upper back, hands just outside the shoulders
Brace, then sit down between your heels
Knees track over toes, drive up through mid-foot
instructions: Set the bar in a rack at chest height, step under it so it rests across your upper back and grip just outside your shoulders.
Stand to lift it off, step back, and set your feet about shoulder width with toes slightly out.
Brace and sit down between your heels, knees tracking over your toes, until your thighs reach about parallel.
Drive up through your mid foot to stand tall. Walk the bar back into the rack when finished.

name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Set the bar in the rack at upper-chest height. Step under it so it rests on the front of your shoulders, fingertips under the bar and elbows high.
Unrack it, step back and set your feet about shoulder width.
Keeping the elbows up and the chest tall, squat down as far as you can with a flat back.
Drive back up to standing, then rack the bar when the set is done.

name: Barbell Deadlift
cues: Bar over mid-foot, shins touch it
Flat back, chest up, push the floor away
Lock out with the glutes, no leaning back
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip width and the bar over the middle of your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs, shins touching it, back flat and chest up.
Push the floor away to stand up, keeping the bar close, and finish by squeezing your glutes without leaning back.
Lower the bar back to the floor by pushing your hips back first, then bending your knees.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Soft knees, push the hips back
Stop when the hamstrings are stretched, back flat
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell at your thighs, hands just outside your legs and feet hip width.
Soften your knees and push your hips back, sliding the bar down your thighs.
Lower until your hamstrings feel stretched, keeping your back flat and the bar close.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench, pad on the bar
Squeeze the glutes hard at the top
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the edge of a bench and a padded barbell across your hips.
Plant your feet flat about hip width, tuck your chin and keep your ribs down.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is flat from knees to shoulders, squeezing your glutes hard.
Lower your hips under control until they nearly touch the floor, then repeat.

name: Barbell Calf Raise
cues: Balls of the feet on a plate for range
instructions: Unrack a barbell onto your upper back and step forward to stand with the balls of your feet on a weight plate.
Keep your knees straight and let your heels sink below the plate for a full stretch.
Push up onto your toes as high as you can and pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly back down, and return the bar to the rack when you finish.

name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Use a spotter or safeties near failure
instructions: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar, feet flat, and shoulder blades squeezed together.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it out of the rack over your chest.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest with elbows about 45 degrees from your body, then press it back up.
Rack the bar when the set is done, and use a spotter or safety bars near failure.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench to a moderate incline, lie back under the rack and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull your shoulder blades back and down, then unrack the bar over your upper chest.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, then press it back up until your arms are straight.
Finish the set and guide the bar back into the hooks.

name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
cues: Elbows tucked close to the body
Touch the lower chest, press up
instructions: Lie on a flat bench under the racked bar and grip it with your hands about shoulder width.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with your arms straight.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press the bar back up to straight arms, then rack it after the last rep.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
cues: Press straight up, head through at the top
instructions: Set the bar at upper-chest height in the rack, grip it just outside your shoulders, and step back with feet hip width.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core with the bar resting on your upper chest.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head back then forward under it as it passes your face.
Lower the bar under control back to your upper chest and repeat.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is about 45 degrees, back flat and knees slightly bent.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, keeping your torso still.
Lower it until your arms are straight, then repeat.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand grip at about shoulder width, arms straight.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top without letting your elbows drift forward or your body lean back.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are fully straight.

name: Barbell Shrug
cues: Shoulders straight up to the ears
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs, hands about shoulder width apart.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the top for a moment without rolling your shoulders.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down and repeat.

name: Sumo Deadlift
cues: Wide stance, toes out, hands inside the knees
Knees push out over the toes
Chest up, stand tall with the glutes
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, shins close to the bar.
Squat down and grip the bar with hands inside your knees, chest up and back flat.
Push your knees out and drive through your feet to stand up, finishing tall with your glutes squeezed.
Lower the bar back to the floor under control, keeping it close to your body.

name: Barbell Good Morning
cues: Light bar on the upper back
Soft knees, push the hips back
Flat back; stop at the hamstring stretch
instructions: Set a light barbell across your upper back from the rack and stand with your feet hip width.
With a slight bend in your knees, push your hips back and tip your chest forward, back flat.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up tall, then rack the bar when you finish.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
cues: Pad the bar across the hips
Squeeze at the top, ribs down
instructions: Sit on the mat with your legs straight and roll a padded barbell over your legs until it rests across your hips.
Lie back, bend your knees and plant your feet flat, holding the bar in place with both hands.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders, squeezing your glutes.
Keep your ribs down at the top, then lower your hips slowly to the mat.

name: Barbell Walking Lunge
cues: Bar on the upper back, eyes forward
Long step, back knee toward the floor
instructions: Unrack a barbell onto your upper back, step clear of the rack and stand tall with eyes forward.
Take a long step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through your front heel to stand and bring your back foot through into the next step.
Continue walking forward, alternating legs each rep, then return the bar to the rack.

name: Barbell Step-Up
cues: Push up through the top leg, not the back foot
instructions: Unrack a barbell onto your upper back and stand facing a sturdy bench or box.
Place one whole foot on the bench.
Push through that foot to stand up on the bench, without pushing off the back foot.
Step back down slowly with the same foot first. Finish the set, then switch legs.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
cues: Use a spotter or safeties near failure
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet locked under the pads and your eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it out of the rack.
Lower the bar to your lower chest under control, then press it back up to straight arms.
Rack the bar when done, and use a spotter or safety bars near failure.

name: Barbell Upright Row
cues: Lead with the elbows, stop at chest height
Skip it if your shoulders pinch
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip wider than your shoulders.
Lead with your elbows to pull the bar up along your body.
Stop when the bar reaches chest height and your elbows are about shoulder level.
Lower the bar slowly back to your thighs. Skip this movement if your shoulders pinch.

name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
cues: Pull to the upper chest, elbows out
instructions: Hold a light barbell with a wide overhand grip and hinge forward until your torso is close to parallel with the floor.
Let the bar hang straight down with your back flat.
Pull the bar toward your upper chest, flaring your elbows out wide.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight again.

name: Reverse-Grip Barbell Row
instructions: Hold a barbell with palms facing up, hands about shoulder width, and stand with feet hip width.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Row the bar to your belly button, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight, holding the same hinge.

name: Pendlay Row
cues: Every rep starts from the floor
Pull to the lower chest without standing up
instructions: Stand over a loaded barbell with feet hip width. Hinge until your back is nearly parallel to the floor and grip the bar just outside the knees.
With a flat back, row the bar explosively from the floor to your lower chest.
Lower it back to the floor and let it settle before the next rep.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
cues: Grip the angled part of the bar
instructions: Stand tall holding an EZ bar on the angled grips with palms facing up, arms straight.
Keep your elbows pinned at your sides and curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps briefly at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are fully straight.

name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
cues: Stop just short of locking out
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of your upper arms on the pad, holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up until the forearms are nearly vertical, keeping the upper arms on the pad.
Lower slowly until the arms are almost straight.

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
cues: Lower toward the forehead or just behind it
Start light: elbows dislike big jumps
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar on the angled grips with your arms straight above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind it.
Straighten your elbows to press the bar back up.
Stop with your arms straight above your chest, then repeat.

name: Barbell Overhead Triceps Extension
cues: Elbows point up and stay in
Lower behind the head for a deep stretch
instructions: Stand tall and press a barbell overhead with a grip about shoulder width.
Keep your ribs down and your elbows pointing up and close to your head.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head until you feel a deep stretch.
Straighten your arms to press the bar back overhead, keeping your upper arms still.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
cues: Overhand grip, thumbs over the bar
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip about shoulder width.
Keep your elbows pinned at your sides and wrists straight as you curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
cues: Pause at the bottom on light days
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest, elbows pointing down, feet a little wider than your hips.
Sit down between your heels, keeping the bell close and your chest up.
Go as deep as you can with a flat back, elbows brushing the insides of your knees.
Drive through your whole foot to stand tall.

name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Bells stay close to the legs
instructions: Stand with feet hip width, a kettlebell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back, sliding the bells down the front of your legs.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, back still flat.
Squeeze your glutes to bring your hips forward and stand tall.

name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your sides, or one at your chest, and stand tall.
Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Finish the set on one leg, then switch legs.

name: Sissy Squat
cues: Knees travel forward, hips stay open
Use the support for balance only
Short range is fine at first
instructions: Stand tall holding a door frame or sturdy chair with one hand, feet hip width, heels up.
Push your knees forward and lean back so your body stays in a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower as far as your knees allow, then straighten your knees to come back up.

name: Band Lying Leg Curl
cues: Move farther from the door for more tension
instructions: Anchor a band low in the door, loop it around both ankles and lie face down with your knees just off the mat.
Curl your heels toward your glutes, keeping your hips pressed into the floor.
Squeeze at the top, then straighten your legs slowly against the band.

name: Kettlebell Floor Press
cues: Wrists straight, bells over the elbows
Pause with the arms on the floor
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, a kettlebell in each hand, upper arms resting on the floor.
Press both bells straight up over your chest until your arms are straight.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor, pause, then press again.

name: Band Incline Press
instructions: Anchor a band low in the door, face away and hold a handle in each hand at chest height.
Step forward into a split stance until the band is taut.
Press up and forward until your hands meet in front of your eyes, arms straight.
Lower the hands back to your chest under control.

name: Band Chest Press
cues: Control the band on the way back
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height in the door, face away and hold a handle in each hand beside your chest.
Step forward into a split stance until the band is taut.
Press straight forward until your arms are straight, then return slowly.

name: Band Chest Fly
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height in the door, face away and hold a handle in each hand with your arms out wide.
Step forward until the band pulls your arms back slightly, elbows softly bent.
Hug your arms together in front of your chest, then let them open slowly.

name: Kettlebell Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a kettlebell in one hand, palm facing forward, arm straight.
Curl the bell up toward your shoulder, keeping your elbow at your side.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Finish the set, then switch arms.

name: Kettlebell Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the handle at your side, thumb pointing forward.
Curl the bell up toward your shoulder without turning your wrist.
Lower it slowly. Finish the set, then switch arms.

name: Band Curl
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band, feet hip width, holding a handle in each hand with palms forward.
Curl both hands up toward your shoulders, elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Band Hammer Curl
