instructions: Stand on the middle of a band, holding a handle in each hand with palms facing in.
Curl both hands up toward your shoulders, thumbs leading.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Band Behind-the-Back Curl
instructions: Anchor a band low in the door, face away and hold the handle in one hand with your arm reaching back behind you.
Step forward until the band is taut and your arm is stretched behind your body.
Curl the handle forward and up without letting your elbow drift forward much.
Lower back into the stretch slowly. Finish the set, then switch arms.

name: Band Lat Pulldown
cues: Elbows drive down to the ribs
instructions: Anchor a band high in the door and kneel facing it, a handle in each hand with arms reaching up.
Move back until the band is taut.
Pull your elbows down to your sides, bringing your hands toward your shoulders.
Let your arms rise slowly back overhead.

name: Band Single-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band high in the door and half kneel facing it, holding the handle in one hand overhead.
Pull your elbow down to your side, letting your torso stay tall.
Let the arm rise slowly until your lat stretches. Finish the set, then switch arms.

name: Kettlebell One-Arm Row
cues: Pull to the hip, not the chest
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance and hinge forward, one hand on your front thigh, a kettlebell hanging in the other hand.
Row the bell toward your hip, keeping your back flat.
Lower it until your arm is straight. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Band Seated Row
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight, the band looped around your feet, a handle in each hand.
Sit tall and pull the handles to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let your arms straighten slowly without rounding forward.

name: Kettlebell Gorilla Row
cues: Push the other bell into the floor
instructions: Set two kettlebells between your feet, stand a little wider than shoulder width and hinge to grab both handles.
With a flat back, row one bell to your hip while pushing the other into the floor.
Lower it, then row the other side. Keep alternating.

name: Band Face Pull
instructions: Anchor a band at face height in the door, hold an end in each hand with palms down and step back until it is taut.
Pull the band toward your forehead, spreading your hands apart and lifting your elbows high.
Pause, then let your arms extend slowly.

name: Band Pull-Apart
cues: Shoulders down, away from the ears
instructions: Stand tall holding a band in front of your chest with both hands, arms straight and hands shoulder width.
Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Bring your hands back together slowly.

name: Kettlebell Shrug
instructions: Stand tall with a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second, then lower slowly.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
instructions: Stand tall with a kettlebell resting at one shoulder, the bell on the outside of your forearm.
Brace and press it straight overhead until your arm is straight and your bicep is by your ear.
Lower it back to your shoulder under control. Finish the set, then switch arms.

name: Band Overhead Press
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band, a handle in each hand at shoulder height.
Press both hands overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders slowly.

name: Band Lateral Raise
cues: One arm at a time if the band is too heavy
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band, a handle in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
Lower them slowly to your sides.

name: Band Upright Row
cues: Elbows lead, out to the sides
Hands a little wider than the hips
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band, holding a handle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Pull your hands up along your body to chest height, elbows leading and higher than your wrists.
Lower them slowly.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand or sit tall holding one kettlebell by the horns, bell behind your head and elbows pointing up.
Straighten your arms to lift the bell overhead.
Lower it slowly behind your head, elbows staying narrow.

name: Band Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Anchor a band low in the door, face away and hold it with both hands behind your head, elbows pointing forward.
Step forward until it is taut, then straighten your arms up and forward.
Bend your elbows to let your hands come back behind your head slowly.

name: Band Triceps Pushdown
cues: Spread the ends at the bottom
instructions: Anchor a band high in the door and hold an end in each hand, elbows bent at your sides.
Push your hands down until your arms are straight.
Let your hands rise slowly to about chest height, elbows staying put.
